passage.text: Hi, Nam! Come to my place on Saturday!
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! ˈkʌm tə maɪ ˈpleɪs ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ!

passage.text: From the big supermarket, go past the market.
passage.reading: frəm ðə ˈbɪɡ ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt, ˈɡoʊ ˈpæst ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt.

passage.text: Cross the street at the traffic light and go two blocks.
passage.reading: ˈkrɔːs ðə ˈstriːt ət ðə ˈtræfɪk ˌlaɪt ənd ˈɡoʊ ˈtuː ˈblɑːks.

passage.text: My building is next to the post office.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈbɪldɪŋ ɪz ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈpoʊst ˌɔːfɪs.
